scoring.perPageDenominator: Initial applicable axe passing rule count plus unique canonical findings, minimum10. Same passed rule denominator for all three modes.
scoring.globalDenominator: Official merger deduplicated passed statements plus global unique findings; per-page mean is not the official global score.
scoring.caveat: Scores are audit indices, not WCAG conformance claims. Skill reference additive -7/-3 formula and alternate grade thresholds are not used.
